_note: Hand-labeled by the project author based on real event-production review experience. Each entry lists the finding types that SHOULD be escalated for that event, used as ground truth for precision/recall scoring. This is a small, honest eval set (3 events) appropriate for a portfolio demo -- see README for how this would scale.

event_1002.note: Guest count change (medium severity) is intentionally left unlabeled -- reasonable reviewers could argue either way, which is exactly the kind of case the eval set should be honest about rather than force a label onto.
